BAIL APPLICATION No. - 29155 of 2022 Applicant :- Kanhaiya Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Archana Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Balbeer Singh Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Ms. Archana Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri V.K. Rai, learned A.G.A. for the State, Sri Balbeer Singh, learned counsel for the complainant and perused the entire record.

The instant application for bail has been moved on behalf of the applicant, Kanhaiya with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in F.I.R./Case Crime No.192 of 2017, under Sections 376 I.P.C. and 5K, 5M/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Etmaddaula, District, Agra, during pendency of the trial.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the innocent applicant has been falsely implicated in this case due to some previous enmity between the family members of the present applicant and the first informant.
She has also submitted that the manner in which the alleged offence is stated to have been committed is very unnatural and improbable.
The place of occurrence is stated to be the house of the victim where the applicant is stated to have committed rape upon the victim.
Learned counsel for the applicant has also submitted that the accused/applicant is languishing in jail since 16.05.2017, who has no previous criminal history.

sentences.text: His further submission is that in case, the applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and he will also fully cooperate with the trial court in getting the trial concluded expeditiously.
He has also submitted that the applicant will not intimidate or pressurize the witnesses or any other persons acquainted with the facts of the present case.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail by submitting that the age of the victim is about nine years.
She is deaf and dumb and mentally challenged also.
She is kept tied in the house so that she may not go somewhere else.
They have also submitted that the present applicant has committed a heinous offence of rape upon such a hapless victim.
Therefore, the offence being heinous in nature, the present applicant does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.

Having heard the learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and upon perusal of record, it transpires that the first information report came to be lodged against the present named applicant, who is stated to have been seen by the mother and uncle of the victim while the applicant was committing rape upon the victim, who is aged about 9 years only.
The victim is deaf and dumb and is mentally challenged also.
There is nothing on record to show that the applicant is being falsely implicated in this case.
Such offence against young victim of tender age of about nine years has an adverse societal effect also.

Thus, having regard to the aforesaid overall facts and circumstances of this case and also keeping in view the arguments advanced on behalf of the parties, nature and manner of commission of offence and evidence regarding the complicity of applicant, no case for bail, at this stage, is made out.
Accordingly, the instant application for bail is rejected.

However, keeping in view the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 16.05.2017, the learned trial court concerned is directed to get the trial concluded with utmost expedition, without granting any unnecessary adjournments to the parties, preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy/computerized copy of this order, in case there is no other legal impediment.
S.S.P./S.P. and Joint Director Prosecution of the district concerned are directed to ensure that witnesses are present on the date fixed before the trial Court so that their testimonies may be recorded without there being any hindrance.
Office is directed to communicate this order to the S.S.P/S.P. and Joint Director Prosecution of the district concerned as well as trial court concerned separately for necessary compliance through email/fax, forthwith.
It is made clear that the trial of the aforesaid case shall be conducted without being influenced by any observation made herein above which are confined to the disposal of the instant bail application.
